title: Tahoe Lake Tours

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Experience the pristine beauty of Lake Tahoe aboard our Formula 260 with a Captain/Guide. Enjoy a private boat tour for 2-hours up to 4-hours. Take in the sights with family and friends from Emerald Bay to the lesser-traveled coves, beaches, and landmarks around the lake. Along the way we can drop anchor for a swim in the Caribbean colored water or enjoy a packed lunch, snacks and beverages. It’s time to board your very own private boat, kick back and enjoy a special occasion or just an outing on Lake Tahoe.
